[USER] User inquired about what to expect during an acupuncture session.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The acupuncturist will ask about medical history, symptoms, and concerns, and may examine the tongue and feel the pulse.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a list of general tips on what to expect during an acupuncture session:  
1. Acupuncturist will ask about medical history, symptoms, and concerns.  
2. User will lie down on a comfortable table, and thin, sterile needles will be inserted into specific points on the body.  
3. User may feel a slight sensation like a pinch or dull ache when needles are inserted, but it should not be painful.  
4. User will be left alone to relax with the needles for about 20 to 40 minutes, during which they may feel calmness and relaxation.  
5. After the session, the acupuncturist will remove the needles and may offer herbal remedies or self-care advice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is crucial to communicate openly with the acupuncturist throughout the session and inform them of any discomfort.
